cloridrato de amitriptilina

dose_adult.note: Ambulatorial: 75 mg/dia em doses divididas (ou 50–100 mg ao deitar), até 150 mg/dia. Internados: 100 mg/dia no início, até 200 mg/dia; poucos precisam de até 300 mg/dia. Manutenção usual: 50–100 mg/dia (40 mg/dia basta para alguns).

cite.locator: seção DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Initial Dosage for Adults
cite.quote: For outpatients 75 mg of amitriptyline HCl a day in divided doses is usually satisfactory. If necessary, this may be increased to a total of 150 mg per day.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "A small number of hospitalized patients may need as much as 300 mg a day." Seção Maintenance: "The usual maintenance dosage of amitriptyline HCl is 50 to 100 mg per day."

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Suicidality and Antidepressant Drugs
cite.quote: Antidepressants increased the risk compared to placebo of suicidal thinking and behavior (suicidality) in children, adolescents, and young adults in short-term studies of major depressive disorder (MDD) and other psychiatric disorders.

The development of a potentially life-threatening serotonin syndrome has been reported with tricyclic antidepressants, including amitriptyline hydrochloride, alone but particularly with concomitant use of other serotonergic drugs
cite.note: Mesma seção: "The concomitant use of amitriptyline hydrochloride with MAOIs intended to treat psychiatric disorders is contraindicated."

cite.locator: seção WARNINGS: Screening Patients for Bipolar Disorder
cite.quote: treating such an episode with an antidepressant alone may increase the likelihood of precipitation of a mixed/manic episode in patients at risk for bipolar disorder
cite.note: Seção PRECAUTIONS: "Depressed patients, particularly those with known manic-depressive illness, may experience a shift to mania or hypomania."

cite.quote: It should be used with caution in patients with a history of seizures

It should be used with caution in patients with a history of seizures and, because of its atropine-like action, in patients with a history of urinary retention, angle-closure glaucoma or increased intraocular pressure.
cite.note: Seção PRECAUTIONS: Geriatric Use: "Geriatric patients are particularly sensitive to the anticholinergic side effects of tricyclic antidepressants including amitriptyline hydrochloride."

cite.quote: Amitriptyline hydrochloride may enhance the response to alcohol and the effects of barbiturates and other CNS depressants.

facts.note: A bula cita o QT na contraindicação com cisaprida; em WARNINGS, cita arritmias e prolongamento do tempo de condução com tricíclicos.

cite.quote: Amitriptyline hydrochloride should not be given with cisapride due to the potential for increased QT interval and increased risk for arrhythmia.
cite.note: Seção WARNINGS: "Tricyclic antidepressant drugs, including amitriptyline hydrochloride, particularly when given in high doses, have been reported to produce arrhythmias, sinus tachycardia, and prolongation of the conduction time."

cite.quote: Hyponatremia has occurred as a result of treatment with amitriptyline hydrochloride tablets. In many cases, hyponatremia appears to be the result of the syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion (SIADH).

The pupillary dilation that occurs following use of many antidepressant drugs including amitriptyline hydrochloride may trigger an angle-closure attack in a patient with anatomically narrow angles who does not have a patent iridectomy.
Deaths may occur from overdosage with this class of drugs.
cite.note: Seção WARNINGS: "Prescriptions for amitriptyline hydrochloride tablets should be written for the smallest quantity of tablets consistent with good patient management, in order to reduce the risk of overdose."

cite.locator: seção PRECAUTIONS: Drug Interactions (Drugs Metabolized by P450 2D6)
cite.quote: Concomitant use of tricyclic antidepressants with drugs that can inhibit cytochrome P450 2D6 may require lower doses than usually prescribed for either the tricyclic antidepressant or the other drug.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "An individual who is stable on a given dose of TCA may become abruptly toxic when given one of these inhibiting drugs as concomitant therapy."

cite.quote: Amitriptyline HCl is an antidepressant with sedative effects.
cite.note: Seção DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: "A sedative effect may be apparent before the antidepressant effect is noted"

cite.quote: After prolonged administration, abrupt cessation of treatment may produce nausea, headache, and malaise.

facts.note: A bula diz que a relação causal não foi estabelecida; houve teratogenicidade em camundongos e hamsters em doses altas.

cite.locator: seção WARNINGS: Usage in Pregnancy (Teratogenic Effects)
cite.quote: Although a causal relationship has not been established, there have been a few reports of adverse events, including CNS effects, limb deformities, or developmental delay, in infants whose mothers had taken amitriptyline during pregnancy.

Because of the potential for serious adverse reactions in nursing infants from amitriptyline, a decision should be made whether to discontinue nursing or to discontinue the drug, taking into account the importance of the drug to the mother.
It should not be given concomitantly with monoamine oxidase inhibitors.

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Suicidality and Antidepressant Drugs
cite.quote: Patients of all ages who are started on antidepressant therapy should be monitored appropriately and observed closely for clinical worsening, suicidality, or unusual changes in behavior.

schedule.text: Bula: acompanhar de perto sobretudo nos primeiros meses e a cada mudança de dose, para mais ou para menos. NICE (depressão, 18 a 25 anos ou risco aumentado de suicídio): reavaliar 1 semana após iniciar ou aumentar a dose e, depois, quantas vezes for preciso, sem passar de 4 semanas após o início.

cites.locator: seção WARNINGS: Clinical Worsening and Suicide Risk
cites.quote: All patients being treated with antidepressants for any indication should be monitored appropriately and observed closely for clinical worsening, suicidality, and unusual changes in behavior, especially during the initial few months of a course of drug therapy, or at times of dose changes, either increases or decreases.
When prescribing antidepressant medication for people with depression who are aged 18 to 25 years or are thought to be at increased risk of suicide:
review them 1 week after starting the antidepressant medication or increasing the dose for suicidality
review them again after this as often as needed, but no later than 4 weeks after the appointment at which the antidepressant was started

titration.steps: Começar com dose baixa e subir aos poucos. Habitual: 75 mg/dia em doses divididas, podendo chegar a 150 mg/dia (aumentos de preferência nas doses do fim da tarde e/ou de deitar). Alternativa: 50 a 100 mg ao deitar, com aumentos de 25 ou 50 mg na dose noturna até 150 mg/dia.
titration.note: O efeito antidepressivo pode levar até 30 dias. Manutenção habitual: 50 a 100 mg/dia (40 mg/dia bastam para alguns), em dose única ao deitar, por 3 meses ou mais.

cites.locator: seção DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Oral Dosage
cites.quote: Dosage should be initiated at a low level and increased gradually, noting carefully the clinical response and any evidence of intolerance.

cites.locator: seção DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Initial Dosage for Adults
cites.quote: For outpatients 75 mg of amitriptyline HCl a day in divided doses is usually satisfactory. If necessary, this may be increased to a total of 150 mg per day. Increases are made preferably in the late afternoon and/or bedtime doses.

cites.locator: seção DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Initial Dosage for Adults
cites.quote: An alternate method of initiating therapy in outpatients is to begin with 50 to 100 mg amitriptyline HCl at bedtime. This may be increased by 25 or 50 mg as necessary in the bedtime dose to a total of 150 mg per day.

cites.locator: seção DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Initial Dosage for Adults
cites.quote: A sedative effect may be apparent before the antidepressant effect is noted, but an adequate therapeutic effect may take as long as 30 days to develop.

The usual maintenance dosage of amitriptyline HCl is 50 to 100 mg per day. In some patients 40 mg per day is sufficient. For maintenance therapy the total daily dosage may be given in a single dose preferably at bedtime.
It is appropriate to continue maintenance therapy 3 months or longer, to lessen the possibility of relapse.

titration.steps: Início: 100 mg/dia, aumentando aos poucos até 200 mg/dia, se necessário; alguns poucos precisam de até 300 mg/dia.

cites.locator: seção DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Initial Dosage for Adults
cites.quote: Hospitalized patients may require 100 mg a day initially. This can be increased gradually to 200 mg a day if necessary. A small number of hospitalized patients may need as much as 300 mg a day.

titration.steps: Em geral, doses menores; 10 mg 3x/dia mais 20 mg ao deitar podem bastar para quem não tolera doses maiores.

cites.locator: seção DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Adolescent and Elderly Patients
cites.quote: In general, lower dosages are recommended for these patients. Ten mg 3 times a day with 20 mg at bedtime may be satisfactory in adolescent and elderly patients who do not tolerate higher dosages.

titration.steps: A bula não traz esquema de retirada. NICE: reduzir até zero em etapas de uma fração da dose anterior (ex.: 50%), com reduções menores (ex.: 25%) nas doses baixas, esperando 1 a 2 semanas entre as etapas; meia-vida curta pede retirada mais lenta.
titration.note: A NICE inclui os tricíclicos entre os antidepressivos que podem causar sintomas de retirada. Com sintomas mais intensos, considerar voltar à dose anterior e depois reduzir mais devagar.

cites.quote: withdrawal symptoms can be experienced with a wide range of antidepressant medication (including tricyclic antidepressants [TCAs], selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors [SSRIs], serotonin–norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors [SNRIs], and monoamine oxidase inhibitors [MAOIs]

slowly reduce the dose to zero in a step-wise fashion, at each step prescribing a proportion of the previous dose (for example, 50% of previous dose) consider using smaller reductions (for example, 25%) as the dose becomes lower

take into account the pharmacokinetic profile (for example, the half-life of the medication as antidepressants with a short half-life will need to be tapered more slowly) and the duration of treatment
allow 1 to 2 weeks to evaluate the effects of dose reduction before considering further dose reductions.

If a person has more severe withdrawal symptoms, consider restarting the original antidepressant medication at the previous dose, and then attempt dose reduction at a slower rate with smaller decrements after symptoms have resolved.

review.notes: Titulação, retirada e calendário de monitoramento adicionados por IA em 2026-10-28, pendentes da segunda conferência humana.
